paragraphs: Getting started at 37signals involves a lot of little details, a number of big tasks, learning the details of your new job, meeting new coworkers, all while working remotely. Your teammates, your manager, your 37signals buddy, your Ops buddy, and our People team are all here to help as you navigate your first few days and weeks.

Before you start, the People team will order you a new computer with the specs you request and any accessories you need like an external keyboard, mouse, or display. Get what you need, while keeping in mind the demands of your work when choosing specs. Everyone working on ops, SIP, or writing Ruby for product should be running Omarchy. Everyone else are invited to run either Omarchy or a Mac.

A day or two before you start, your manager will email you instructions for your first day. Your manager will be your point of contact for your early projects and activities. You’ll also work with a member of our Ops team who will help you as you set up all the accounts you need to work at 37signals.

On your first day, you’ll log into Basecamp to see a project dedicated to your onboarding called “Welcome, [your name]!”. Your welcome project will contain a few to-do lists, tailored to your role and linking to accounts or services that you need to set up. You’ll also see to-do lists that your Ops buddy and manager will be working through. Your Ops buddy and your manager will be in contact with you as you set up your environment, should you have questions or get stuck.
translations: 在 37signals 开始工作涉及许多细节、多项大任务、学习新工作的细节、认识新同事，同时还要远程工作。您的队友、您的经理、您的 37signals 伙伴、您的 Ops 伙伴以及我们的人力团队都会在您入职的头几天和几周内为您提供帮助。
在您开始工作之前，人力团队会根据您的要求订购一台新电脑，以及您需要的任何配件，如外接键盘、鼠标或显示器。在配置规格时，请获取您所需的一切，同时考虑您工作的需求。所有从事 ops、SIP 或为产品编写 Ruby 的员工都应该运行 Omarchy。其他人可以选择运行 Omarchy 或 Mac。
在您开始工作的一两天前，您的经理会通过电子邮件发送给您第一天的指导说明。您的经理将是您早期项目和活动的联系人。您还将与我们的 Ops 团队成员合作，帮助您设置在 37signals 工作所需的所有账户。
在您的第一天，您将登录 Basecamp，看到一个专门为您入职的项目，名为“欢迎，[您的姓名]！”。您的欢迎项目将包含几个待办事项列表，根据您的角色定制，并链接到您需要设置的账户或服务。您还会看到您的 Ops 伙伴和经理将要处理的待办事项列表。在您设置环境时，如果您有问题或遇到困难，您的 Ops 伙伴和经理将与您联系。
fullTextParagraphs: Getting started at 37signals involves a lot of little details, a number of big tasks, learning the details of your new job, meeting new coworkers, all while working remotely. Your teammates, your manager, your 37signals buddy, your Ops buddy, and our People team are all here to help as you navigate your first few days and weeks.

Before you start, the People team will order you a new computer with the specs you request and any accessories you need like an external keyboard, mouse, or display. Get what you need, while keeping in mind the demands of your work when choosing specs. Everyone working on ops, SIP, or writing Ruby for product should be running Omarchy. Everyone else are invited to run either Omarchy or a Mac.

A day or two before you start, your manager will email you instructions for your first day. Your manager will be your point of contact for your early projects and activities. You’ll also work with a member of our Ops team who will help you as you set up all the accounts you need to work at 37signals.

On your first day, you’ll log into Basecamp to see a project dedicated to your onboarding called “Welcome, [your name]!”. Your welcome project will contain a few to-do lists, tailored to your role and linking to accounts or services that you need to set up. You’ll also see to-do lists that your Ops buddy and manager will be working through. Your Ops buddy and your manager will be in contact with you as you set up your environment, should you have questions or get stuck.

Your training schedules and onboarding expectations will be in your welcome project. You’ll also find docs with helpful links to technical documentation, walkthrough videos, important Basecamp projects, and more.
Your welcome project will also contain a list of people to meet over the course of your first few weeks.
Your manager. You and your manager will meet on your first day to sort out a recurring 1:1 schedule and to review your specific onboarding expectations.
Your team. Most teams have a weekly call which you’ll join your first week.

Your 37signals buddy. Your buddy will be someone who’s not on your immediate team, who’s worked at 37signals for a while, and who can point you in the right direction when you have a question and don’t quite know where to turn. They’ll introduce themselves during your first week, to say hi and offer their help. They’ll check in with you periodically throughout your first couple months to see how you’re settling in.
People Ops. You’ll meet with Andrea to review 37signals policies, benefits, and compensation.

After your environment has been set up, expectations are clear, and you’ve met who you need to meet, you’ll get to work! You’ll begin working on real projects, with plenty of support and guidance, within your first week. Your responsibilities and impact will increase as you learn and gain confidence over the next few months, and most people are up to speed and feeling fully part of the team in about 3 months.

scenario.title: Helping a new teammate find a useful starting point
english: A new teammate has joined a remote team and is unsure where to begin.
The “Getting Started” guide introduces how the team works, while current project context can help the new teammate prepare for an initial task.
You suggest reading the guide first, reviewing the project, and choosing a first task together.
chinese: 一位新同事加入远程团队，不确定应该从哪里开始。
“Getting Started”指南介绍团队的工作方式；了解当前项目能帮助新人准备第一项任务。
你建议先读指南，再看项目背景，随后一起选定第一项任务。

firstAttempt.prompt: 新同事第一天加入远程团队，不知道从哪里开始。请用英文建议他先看 Getting Started 指南，再设置岗位所需工具；如果不确定优先事项，可以找经理确认。
firstAttempt.sample: Start with the Getting Started guide, then set up the tools you need for your role. If you’re unsure what to tackle first, ask your manager to help set priorities.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先看入门指南、配置岗位工具；不确定时请经理帮助排定优先级。

words.example: The company provides all necessary accessories for remote work.

words.example: The training program is tailored to the specific needs of each department.
words.translation: 培训计划是根据每个部门的具体需求量身定制的。

words.translation: 在访问公司系统之前，你需要先设置账户。

words.example: If you get stuck in the onboarding process, don't hesitate to ask for help.
words.translation: 如果在入职过程中遇到困难，请随时寻求帮助。
words.note: 描述在某个过程中遇到困难而无法继续前进
